<p>Even Na-hyeon came home today.</p><p>​</p><p>Right now, in the living room, Yu-na, Na-hyeon, Ji-hyeon, Echo, Yuria, and Lev are eating fruit together while waiting for the vote-counting broadcast.</p><p>​</p><p>I put in my earphones and turned the music up loud.</p><p>​</p><p>I don’t want to see it.</p><p>​</p><p>I could find out the result today—no, maybe in just a few minutes—from the exit poll, but I don’t want to know.
